title: Adaptive domain decomposition method for time-dependent problems with applications in fluid dynamics
summary: We deal with the numerical solution of the time-dependent partial differential equations using the adaptive space-time discontinuous Galerkin (DG) method. The discretization leads to a nonlinear algebraic system at each time level, the size of the system is varying due to mesh adaptation. A Newton-like iterative solver leads to a sequence of linear algebraic systems which are solved by GMRES solver with a domain decomposition preconditioner.
